name: [⚙UPDATE] Mechanical Ascension X
desc:
You find yourself on a land with unlimited and powerful resources... for what purpose? Money, of course! Build intricate factories to extract, refine, and sell of various materials for profit, which you can then use to improve your factory more! And when you don't think you can go any farther... reset, back to the beginning! Of course, with a little (VERY, VERY BIG) something to help you get even more powerful next time...

How far can you ascend?
Welcome to Mechanical Ascension X!

Join the group for in-game benefits, and news about updates: https://www.roblox.com/communities/581737899/Mechanical-Ascension-X#!/about
